description: Figure 7 illustrates the average rate at which the model attends to different input segments during generation. The horizontal axis represents position, labeled from 1 to 12 with linear spacing, and the vertical axis represents the average rate of attention, labeled “Avg. rate at which the model attends” with a linear scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.70, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Three sets of data are presented as lines with circular data points: “Standard” represented by a blue line, “CinGS (w)” represented by a red line, and “CinGS (w/ context)” represented by a purple line. The “Standard” line begins at approximately 0.62 and fluctuates between 0.58 and 0.65 across all positions. The “CinGS (w)” line begins at approximately 0.48 and generally increases to around 0.55 by position 12, with some fluctuations. The “CinGS (w/ context)” line begins at approximately 0.45 and shows a similar increasing trend to “CinGS (w)”, reaching around 0.53 by position 12, also with fluctuations. Error bars are shown at each data point, indicating variance, but their exact lengths are not easily quantifiable from the image. The lines are not explicitly sorted, and no bars or data points are visually emphasized.
